import json,subprocess,sys,os
def run(obj, cls='/workspace/tmp/classes'):
    data=json.dumps(obj).encode()
    r=subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py',cls],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=180)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print('EXIT',r.returncode,r.stderr.decode()[:3000]); return None
    out=json.loads(r.stdout.decode())
    return out
def show(obj, full=True):
    r=run(obj)
    if r is None: return None
    print(json.dumps(r,indent=1 if full else None))
    return r
